title: dam new request
description: The flags dam new takes, one key per flag without its dashes, and subject for its argument.

path.description: A path such as work/clients/. Default: the root.

due.description: A date word, YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM.

deadline.description: A whole day, read the way due reads one.

start.description: A date word, YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM.

end.description: A date word, YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM.

id.description: The caller's own id; a repeat with the same id changes the same object.

meta.description: The request's details, as --meta KEY=VALUE passes them: harness, session, model, effort, version or any other key.
